name: EPIC 201587420
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.9 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201587420 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.873054 (16th-84th percentiles 8.484912-9.292437), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201587420 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.91923 (16th-84th percentiles 0.818819-1.034482), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201587420: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5039.632000000001 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201587420 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5573.359375 (16th-84th percentiles 5385.78125-5769.0625), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,573 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.92 solar masses and 8.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,040 K at its surface.
